The thing about day-game is, you've got to be quick about it. You open with a joke (which your OP proposes doing - good instinct there) but then, you probably only have like one more sentence to convert it into something. In other words, even if you get a laugh with the joke, you can't just keep chatting her up (like you might do in a bar) because she needs to get on with her business, talk to the checkout clerk, whatever.

To that end, I recommend you cut out the majority of the words in your proposed line. "Hey, we're both buying pillows" is unnecessary. "It must be a sign" is awkward (although, don't worry yourself about being awkward and let it cause you to miss an opportunity - better to try and fail than to wish you had tried).

I suggest that a better line would have been simply, "pillow fight?" and the key is, you sell the line with your smile, your body language, maybe a slightly mischievous look. I think that's better than trying to set it up with the extra words.

Also, note that a pillow fight is an obvious sexual innuendo. That makes it the kind of line/joke that a "bad boy" would use. If you feel that you can pull off the "bad boy" role then that's definitely the best option with the highest chance of success. Girl's dig it. But if you don't think it matches your personality or appearance, then she wont buy it and it wont work.

An alternative to playing the bad boy is to play the funny guy. And an alternative version of this joke that relies less obviously on sexual innuendo is what /u/sakuramboo suggested, something about shopping for mattresses.

Regardless, you tell your little joke, and if she doesn't laugh, then that's the end of the interaction, but at least you tried. If she laughs, but turns away from you, same deal - she's not interested. If she laughs and holds eye contact, then (keeping in mind how little time you have available) the very next thing you should probably do is say your name. And then you need to jump right to the goal of getting a number. I like to go with, "we should hang out."

90% of these attempts are going to fail. That's just life as an average male. You just have to accept it. But if there's a chance it will work, you've got to be really fast. Good luck.
